chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Wassha from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
I said to him, 'The Umrah performed after the Hajj.' He said, 'When the razor enables [shaving] the head.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for performing Umrah after Hajj according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the condition for performing Umrah after Hajj by linking it to the completion of the Hajj rites, specifically the shaving of the head (tahallul). This indicates that the Umrah is not an independent act but rather the concluding ritual that frees the pilgrim from the state of Ihram, a key distinction in Shia jurisprudence regarding Umrat al-Tamattu'. The brevity of the report underscores the direct causal relationship between the Hajj rituals and the subsequent Umrah obligation.
